answer: One lagoon is a pass, one dune is a fare, one crystal is the stamp on the pass, and the stamp cannot be bought at any price. A hundred masks, one demand: can the applicant show each set brooch is a measured gem yield plus a guild signature for Gem polisher set brooch seal faceted in the setting bench? Renewal charges 117 POA every epoch, so the farm's 890 masks bleed 104130 POA again next epoch. The panel does not trust the applicant; it trusts the record, and the record stands open. As a business, farming 890 masks has one line of expense, 104130 POA locked away, and no line of revenue.
